name: program-runtime.research-tools-review
purpose: Read one explicitly authorized Markdown capability inventory, then combine bounded fleet health and per-scenario Agent Manager friction signals without treating missing evidence as clean.

workspace_root.description: Absolute caller-authorized root containing the selected inventory file.

inventory_relative_path.description: Relative Markdown path below workspace_root; entries use a Monitoring scenario field with one or more scenario slugs.

window_days.description: Agent Manager friction window, 1 through 90 days.

assumptions: The caller is authorized to read workspace_root and its selected inventory file.
The inventory follows the documented Markdown convention: level-two capability headings and `- **Monitoring scenario:** `slug`` or plural form.
program-runtime.supervision-sweep and agent-manager.friction-digest remain optional sensors; their failures are returned as unknown or partial evidence.
invariants: Read-only; no health remediation, issue filing, agent dispatch, or other mutation.
The inventory path is resolved below workspace_root; symlinks escaping that root are refused.
At most 16 unique scenario slugs are monitored and at most 8 scenario-specific friction digests are collected; omitted rows are counted and status is partial.
A missing inventory, malformed inventory, unavailable child program, or missing child signal never means no tools, no friction, or healthy.
Scenario health, friction, coverage, and inventory parsing are separate signals; the program does not infer cause or work impact.
Output is bounded to 8 fingerprints per scenario and one fleet-health summary.

signals.inventory: relative path, parse status, capability count and bounded errors
signals.scenario_slugs: unique parsed monitoring slugs, up to 16
signals.health: preserved supervision-sweep status, summary, errors and evidence, or unknown
signals.friction: per-scenario digest status, coverage, counts, top fingerprints and errors, or unknown
signals.omitted_scenarios: number of parsed scenarios beyond the monitoring bound

outputs.evidence: selected inventory path and nested program/artifact identifiers

budget.async_reason: The bounded set of per-scenario Agent Manager friction reads may exceed the synchronous submission limit.
